FOLATE.gloss: a B vitamin that is essential for cell growth and reproduction
FOLATE.definition: A B vitamin that is essential for cell growth and reproduction.

FOETAL.gloss: of or relating to a fetus
FOETAL.definition: Of or relating to a fetus.

FLOAT.gloss: be in motion due to some air or water current
FLOAT.definition: Be in motion due to some air or water current.
FLOAT.example: The leaves were blowing in the wind.

FETAL.gloss: of or relating to a fetus
FETAL.definition: Of or relating to a fetus.

ALOFT.gloss: at or on or to the masthead or upper rigging of a ship
ALOFT.definition: At or on or to the masthead or upper rigging of a ship.
ALOFT.example: Climbed aloft to unfurl the sail.

LEFT.gloss: location near or direction toward the left side
LEFT.definition: Location near or direction toward the left side; i.e. the side to the north when a person or object faces east.

LATE.gloss: being or occurring at an advanced period of time or after a usual or expected time
LATE.definition: Being or occurring at an advanced period of time or after a usual or expected time.

LOT.gloss: a large number or amount or extent
LOT.definition: (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent.

LET.gloss: make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
LET.definition: Make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen.
LET.example: This permits the water to rush in.

FELT.gloss: a fabric made of compressed matted animal fibers
FELT.definition: A fabric made of compressed matted animal fibers.

FAT.gloss: a soft greasy substance occurring in organic tissue and consisting of a mixture of lipids
FAT.definition: A soft greasy substance occurring in organic tissue and consisting of a mixture of lipids (mostly triglycerides).

TEA.gloss: a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water
TEA.definition: A beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water.
TEA.example: Iced tea is a cooling drink.

FLAT.gloss: having a surface without slope, tilt in which no part is higher or lower than another
FLAT.definition: Having a surface without slope, tilt in which no part is higher or lower than another.

FATE.gloss: an event that will inevitably happen in the future
FATE.definition: An event (or a course of events) that will inevitably happen in the future.

TALE.gloss: a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events
TALE.definition: A message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program.

LEAF.gloss: the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants
LEAF.definition: The main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants.
